text:
Rhea (PM): quick thread to settle the priority matrix for Console/Observability GA. we have a long wishlist; need a crisp must/nice list tied to launch criteria and customer pilots.
Diego (Eng): agree. my view: MUST = dashboards (templates + apply), tracing hooks for hot-paths, per-route cost estimate, error grouping + trace links. NICE = anomaly detection, long-retention per-tenant, export adapters.
Anya (SRE): ops POV: MUST also include throttling semantics, visible sampling rates, and rollback triggers. if we miss throttling we risk cluster impact during beta.
Owen (Design): UX tradeoff: including sampling-rate and sample-size inline is non-negotiable. customers asked for it. gallery can be minimal for GA — three templates.
Priya (CS): customer ask: top-10 spend widget + CSV export are high-impact. if GA omits CSV, adoption risk increases.
Lina (Security): residency/legal: MUST have a short doc explaining where traces live, and audit logging for export/config changes. Dedicated customers expect per-tenant KMS notes.
Rhea (PM): proposed launch rubric (all musts are required to GA):
- 3 pilot customers signed and validated
- Dashboard median load <200ms for standard queries
- Trace join fidelity >96% on mirrored traffic
- Per-route cost estimate median error <=7%
- Throttle behavior and fallback tested in CI
- Residency doc + export audit logs
Diego (Eng): implementation notes: we should aim for default sampling 3% with hot-path override 90% for flagged routes. default retention hosted=7d, dedicated=30d. config snippet:
```
tracing.default_sample_rate=0.03
tracing.hot_path_override=0.9
retention.hosted_days=7
retention.dedicated_days=30
throttle.burst=6000
throttle.fallback=summary_traces
```
Diego (Eng): tradeoff: 3% gives cost control but less signal; 5% doubles signal at cost. need product decision.
Anya (SRE): on throttles: fallback to summary traces must be automatic after sustained breach; alerts to oncall when fallback occurs. rollback if canary sees >2% increase in 5xx.
Owen (Design): small UX decisions: show badge states: sampled, throttled, estimated-cost. show tooltip explaining difference between estimated cost vs invoice. link to help article.
Priya (CS): pilot ask: include a short feedback form covering dashboard usefulness, sampling transparency, cost accuracy, and RCA confidence. will use to gate GA.
Lina (Security): export sinks must be admin-protected and recorded in audit log. also require KMS integration notes for Dedicated.
metrics-bot: mirror-job started for pilot customer X at 2024-09-12T14:00Z (5% traffic).
Rhea (PM): action items: Diego -> sampling defaults + throttle doc by Thu. Anya -> SLOs + rollback test plan by Mon. Owen -> gallery mock + badges by Wed. Priya -> pilot list + feedback template by Wed. Lina -> residency + audit checklist by Fri. I'll consolidate into the release gating spreadsheet.
Diego (Eng): one more engineering note: for per-route cost estimates we can ship rough estimates derived from token counts + span counts; mark them as "estimated" and show sample size. full invoice alignment later.
Priya (CS): customers okay with "estimated" as long as we show methodology and margin of error. include CSV export in beta.
Rhea (PM): final call: any MUST additions?
Anya (SRE): add automated alert on sampling-rate drop below expected rate during beta.
Owen (Design): add tiny inline education copy for each cost panel.
Rhea (PM): ok closing thread. I'll publish the prioritization matrix and create JIRAs. please post docs to /docs/observe-roadmap before the sync. :rocket:
